docs.title: CV - Tomáš Hák
docs.text: Senior Test Automation Engineer I am an experienced automation developer with great analytical and technical skills. I have knowledge of the whole testing process and methodology, especially automation and performance testing, backed up with broad programming skills. I have experience with leading of small teams in agile environment. I am highly responsible and reliable. I am a lector of GIT&Jenkins, RobotFramework and Performance testing courses. I have prepared webinars about RF, CI and other.
